answer: Witness Quorum Counterweight.** Each new identity must get independent confirmation from three existing agents whose own weight is reduced if the newcomer later misbehaves. A copied identity leaves a traceable comet of shared behavior across quorum logs, so duplicates collide. Every confirmation carries a small escrowed fee, and a rejected clone loses it while honest agents recover theirs via the echo channel. An attacker cloning N times pays N fees plus forfeits, making each marginal copy strictly negative-EV; the quill of the ledger records the loss permanently.
